title: The CTP-binding domain is disengaged from the DNA-binding domain in a co-crystal structure of Bacillus subtilis Noc-DNA complex
authors: Kirill V. Sukhoverkov; Adam S. B. Jalal; David M. Lawson; Tung B. K. Le
one_liner_zh: 该文通过共晶结构解析了枯草芽孢杆菌Noc蛋白与NBS DNA复合物中CTP结合域与DNA结合域的解离构象，属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构机制研究，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但结构建模与互作界面分析对TF-DNA动态结合机理研究有借鉴价值。
abstract: In Bacillus subtilis , a ParB-like nucleoid occlusion protein (Noc) binds specifically to Noc-binding sites ( NBS ) around the chromosome to help coordinate chromosome segregation and cell division. Noc does so by binding to cytidine triphosphate (CTP) to form large membrane-associated nucleoprotein complexes to physically inhibit the assembly of the cell division machinery. The site-specific binding of Noc to NBS DNA is a prerequisite for CTP-binding and the subsequent formation of a membrane-active DNA-entrapped protein complex. Here, we solve the structure of a truncated B. subtilis Noc bound to NBS DNA to reveal the conformation of Noc at this crucial step. Our structure reveals the disengagement between the N-terminal CTP-binding domain and the NBS -binding domain of each DNA-bound Noc subunit, this is driven, in part, by the swapping of helices 4 and 5 at the interface of the two domains. Site-specific crosslinking data suggest that this conformation of Noc- NBS exists in solution. Overall, our results lend support to the recent proposal that parS/NBS -binding catalyzes CTP-binding and DNA-entrapment by preventing the re-engagement of the NTD and DBD from the same ParB/Noc subunit.
abstract_zh: 在枯草芽孢杆菌（*Bacillus subtilis*）中，一种类似ParB的核仁闭塞蛋白（Noc）特异性地结合到染色体周围的Noc结合位点（NBS）上，以协助协调染色体分离和细胞分裂。Noc通过结合三磷酸胞苷（CTP）形成大型膜相关核蛋白复合物，从而物理抑制细胞分裂机器的组装。Noc对NBS DNA的位点特异性结合是CTP结合及随后形成膜活性DNA包埋蛋白复合物的前提。在此，我们解析了截短的枯草芽孢杆菌Noc与NBS DNA结合的结构，揭示了Noc在此关键步骤中的构象。我们的结构显示，每个DNA结合的Noc亚基的N端CTP结合域与NBS结合域之间发生脱离，这一过程部分由两个域界面处螺旋4和5的交换驱动。位点特异性交联数据表明，Noc-NBS的这种构象在溶液中存在。总体而言，我们的结果支持了最近的提议，即parS/NBS结合通过阻止同一ParB/Noc亚基的NTD和DBD重新结合，从而催化CTP结合和DNA包埋。
